messages.content: Friday dinner moved to 6:00 p.m. at a restaurant near 27th and Larimer in RiNo. The last forum session at the venue hotel ends at 5:15. Can I get there by rail and walking, or should I take a rideshare?

Leave the session promptly at 5:15. Rail plus walking would take about 30-35 minutes if the connection lines up, putting you there around 5:50-5:55 with little margin. A rideshare should take 15-25 minutes in Friday traffic, so a 5:20 pickup is the more workable plan.
Use the rideshare. I will return to the Union Station hotel after dinner. What does that do to the transportation estimate?

Allow about $18-$24 to RiNo and $13-$18 back to Union Station, including typical Friday-evening variability. Using $42 as the reimbursable dinner-transport allowance raises local transportation from $103 to $145 and the trip estimate from $760.52 to $802.52. The flights still need to be ticketed.
